options.description: Recommended because you edit next to the PDF you are looking at, and nothing already reviewed is overwritten. resume.md and cover-letter.md sit at the top of each release folder; one command builds the next revision (r07) from your edits with the same checks. r06 stays untouched and its reviews stay valid.
options.label: Edit the release copy, new revision (Recommended)

options.description: Release folders stay read-only (the .md copies move to the top for reading only). You edit applications/<job>/resume.md, away from the PDFs, and one command builds the next revision.
options.label: Edit the application source

options.description: Edit the .md in r06 and re-render r06 itself. Simplest to use, but r06's recorded reviews and integrity check no longer match its files.
options.label: Overwrite the PDFs in place

payload.question: Each release folder (e.g. outputs/<job>/r06/) is a frozen, hashed snapshot that reviews are recorded against, and it already holds a copy of resume.md and cover-letter.md, buried under inputs/. Where should you edit when you want to tweak a document yourself?
payload.text: Edit the release copy, new revision (Recommended)
